resources.string: Reading PS5 subtitles and translating them into Turkish
PS5 is in another Remote Play session. Close the other device.
PS5 not found at %1$s. Make sure it is on and on the same network. Reconnecting…
The PS5 rejected the connection (code %1$s). Another Remote Play app (PS Remote Play) may be open, or the PS5 may be in another session. Close PS Remote Play, restart the PS5, then try again.
The PS5 didn\'t start the session. Another Remote Play app (PS Remote Play) may be open, or the PS5 may be in another session. Close PS Remote Play, restart the PS5, then try again.
The PS5 didn\'t accept this pairing. Pair the PS5 again with the second account in Settings.
Remote Play is turned off on the PS5. On the PS5, open Settings › System › Remote Play and turn on Enable Remote Play, then start again.
No picture from the PS5. Is Remote Play turned off, or is the PS5 in rest mode? Check, then start translating again.
PS5 not found on the network. Are the phone and PS5 on the same network?
PS5 did not wake from rest mode.
The PS5 asks for this account\'s login passcode. Enter it in Settings, or turn off this account\'s login passcode on the PS5.
The PS5 didn\'t accept the login passcode in Settings. Correct it, or turn off this account\'s login passcode on the PS5.
PS5 refused the connection. Pair again.
Sign in to PSN and pair your PS5 first.
The Remote Play library could not be loaded on this device.
The subtitle server could not start (port 8787 is in use).
Translation is unavailable right now; retrying.
The free translation model could not be downloaded. Check your internet connection.
No text found on the screen.
Couldn\'t capture the screen: no picture from the PS5 yet.
In games without Turkish, your phone reads the English subtitles and translates them into Turkish. You play as usual.
All the text of popular games is already translated, for free. Subtitles arrive instantly, without internet. Other games use free translation.
Show subtitles on the TV over the game, or in large type on your phone. Setup takes a few minutes.
The phone connects to your PS5 with Remote Play. Sign in with a free second PSN account, separate from the one you play with.
If the page doesn\'t appear, you can sign in in your browser below.
You can try again, or sign in in your phone\'s browser and paste the address here.

Sign in with your second account in the browser that opens. When you finish, the browser does not come back to the app by itself: it stays on a remoteplay.dl.playstation.net page that only says \"redirect\". Tap the address bar, copy the whole address and switch back to Nino. The app picks up the copied address by itself; if it does not, paste it below and tap Next.
Google sign-in does not open inside the app (Google does not allow it), so sign-in moved to the browser. You can choose \"Continue with Google\" there again.
This address has no sign-in code. It should start with https://remoteplay.dl.playstation.net/remoteplay/redirect?code=
Couldn\'t reach the internet or Sony. Check your connection.
The page took too long to open.
Couldn\'t make a secure connection (are the date and time right?).
The page stayed blank; Sony\'s sign-in app didn\'t run in this phone\'s in-app browser.
The in-app browser (Android System WebView) didn\'t work. Try updating it from the Play Store.
Something went wrong while loading the page.
On the PS5, with the second account, choose Settings › System › Remote Play › Pair Device and enter the code shown.
Turn your PS5 on or leave it in rest mode; it shows up here by itself once found. Your phone and PS5 must be on the same Wi-Fi.
On the TV, over the game
The Nino TV app finds this phone by itself when opened. This phone can install the TV app (Samsung, LG, Android TV); no computer needed.
No TV seen on the network (it may be off; that\'s fine).
Tap after opening the game on your PS5. The phone receives the picture, reads the subtitles and translates them.
On the TV over the game, or on this phone. Tap to change.
In supported games, pre-translated subtitles arrive instantly. Free.
Your devices, PSN account, notifications and translation engine are here.
No packs found. While online, tap Update packs.
Add a community translation file (JSON, TXT or bilingual SRT) as a game pack. The file stays on this phone and is not sent anywhere.
A game pack with this ID already exists. Replacing it will overwrite the installed pack.
The translation file could not be read.
The translation file could not be imported. Check its format and encoding.
The file contains no usable translations.
The game pack could not be installed.
%1$s is removed from this phone. To use it again, import the file again.
Keep previous lines above in fast dialogue
When off, each new line replaces the previous one. Needs TV app 0.9.16 or later.

If the PS5 picture stays black inside the Nino TV app, choose Overlay: the TV shows the PS5 on its own HDMI input and the subtitles appear on top. If no picture arrives, the TV app first lists its HDMI inputs and switches to Overlay where it can. The TV app from Google Play has no Overlay mode: there this choice is not applied and the TV says so on screen.
Keep the PS5, TV and phone on the same network
With your own account, on the TV

When Remote Play connects with the same account, it takes over your session and controller. The second account only receives the picture; you keep playing with your own account and controller. The account is free, no PS Plus needed.
When you turn on the controller to play, choose your MAIN account on the PS5. Don\'t play with the second account Nino signs in with, or the controller won\'t work in the game.
The code is valid for 5 minutes. If something fails, the reason appears here.
The PS5 did not recognize this PSN account. Make sure you took the code from the screen opened with the second account.
Code not accepted. Enter the new code from the PS5.
The PS5 is in another Remote Play session right now.
The PS5 system software is not compatible with this version. Update the PS5.
Remote Play stopped on the PS5. Restart the PS5 and try again.
This address could not be resolved. Check the PS5\'s IP address.
The PS5 did not respond. Are the phone and PS5 on the same Wi-Fi?
The PS5 received the code but did not respond. Try again.
You can change this later from the home screen.
Looking for TVs on the network…
No TV, or the TV app isn\'t installed
Open the game on your PS5, then start.
You can already browse the packs and settings.
To connect to your PS5, pair it in Settings.
GTA V, RDR2, Mafia and more
Lines that are not in a pack go to the shared pool with the game\'s name, so its ready translation comes sooner.
If no pack recognises the game, asked once two minutes after translation starts.
Keeps the character\'s name in front of the translation (ARTHUR: …). The name itself is never translated.
Check unchanged subtitle areas more often
When the subtitle area looks unchanged, read it again after 2 frames instead of 20. Uses more CPU.
Play Xbox sound on this device
Xbox remote play sends the sound to this device; if you turn this off, the game may stay silent.
Screen stays on · brightness dims automatically
The pack is chosen automatically when the game opens. Lines not in the pack are translated with your chosen engine. Packs are free; new ones and fixes download automatically.
New packs and fixes download automatically once a week
In games with a ready pack, this engine only translates missing lines.
Drag the slider all the way to the end to make the background fully solid and hide the English subtitle in the game. A full-width band also covers the sides.
Cover: the translation hides the English subtitle in the game. Choose Above or Below to see the English subtitle too, with the translation right above or below it.
A sample subtitle appears on the TV when you let go of the slider. In fixed position you can also move subtitles with the ▲ and ▼ buttons on the TV remote.
Only needed if the second account has a login passcode on the PS5. Nino enters it when the PS5 asks; it is stored encrypted on the phone.

When off, all lines are translated with your chosen engine.
Nino has no accounts: your settings stay only on this phone. The app and game packs are free.
Install the TV app from this phone
Installs and updates the Nino TV app on your Samsung, LG or Android TV from this phone, without a computer. Looking for the TV on your network; you can change the brand later.
A new version of the TV app is available
Nino on the %1$s TV is %2$s, this phone has %3$s. Updating takes about a minute; keep the TV on and on the same Wi-Fi.
Download and install the latest Nino.
Installs the Nino TV app on your Samsung TV from this phone, without a computer. The phone and the TV must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Samsung TVs and smart monitors (2016 and later; 2016–2018 models are experimental).
No Samsung TV found. Is the TV on and on the same Wi-Fi? You can also type its address below (on the TV: Settings › General › Network › Network Status).
Host PC IP belongs to another device: %1$s
Turn on developer mode on the TV
2. Press 1 2 3 4 5 on the remote (or type 12345 on the on-screen keypad). The Developer mode window opens. On some new models this works on Apps › App Settings.
3. Turn Developer mode On, type this phone\'s address as Host PC IP and press OK:
4. Restart the TV: hold the power button on the remote for about 2 seconds until the TV turns off, then turn it on again. A short press only puts it on standby.
Could not find this phone\'s address; is it on Wi-Fi?

The first install asks you to sign in once with a free Samsung account: Samsung only accepts the app signed with a certificate made for your TV. If the phone\'s address changes, repeat the Host PC IP step.
Getting a certificate for your TV from Samsung…
Installing on the TV… (this can take a minute)
Removing the old copy from the TV…
Opening the app on the TV…
The Google Play page opened on the TV: press Install (or Update) with the TV remote. The app opens by itself once it is installed.
Installed: Nino %1$s is opening on the TV.

Nino opens its waiting screen on the TV. Even if it mentions a computer, that is not an error: the TV is waiting for the phone. Now tap Start translation on the home screen; the TV finds this phone by itself.
Nino %1$s is already on the TV; opening it.
If the TV shows “Server under maintenance”, it cannot reach Samsung\'s servers: check the TV\'s internet connection and its date and time, restart the TV and try again.
The TV did not accept this phone. In the TV\'s Developer mode window, check that Host PC IP is this phone\'s address (%1$s), then restart the TV (hold the power button for about 2 seconds).
This Samsung TV is too old for the Nino TV app (2016 models and later are supported).
Samsung sign-in did not complete. Try again and finish signing in on the page that opens.
Samsung did not issue the signing certificate. Try again in a few minutes.
The TV is out of free space. Remove an app you do not use from the TV and try again.
A Nino TV app signed on another device is still on the TV and could not be removed. On the TV, open Apps, select Nino, delete it and try again.

The TV did not accept the signing certificate. Make sure the TV is connected to the internet (it checks the certificate with Samsung) and its date and time are right (Settings › General › System Manager › Time), then try again. Nino gets a new certificate, so you sign in to Samsung once more.
The TV\'s clock is behind, so the new certificate is not valid for it yet. Set the TV\'s date and time (Settings › General › System Manager › Time) or wait a few minutes, then try again.

The TV refuses Nino because an earlier Nino is still registered on it (Tizen error 118, -22), even if it no longer appears among the apps. If Nino is among the TV\'s apps, delete it there and try again. Otherwise reset Smart Hub (Settings › Support › Device Care › Self Diagnosis › Reset Smart Hub) and try again. Resetting Smart Hub also removes the other apps you downloaded.
The connection to the TV dropped during the install. Keep the TV on and on the same Wi-Fi as this phone, keep the phone\'s screen on, then try again.
The TV app could not be installed. Try again; if it fails again, send us the install log.
This phone app does not contain the TV package. Update the app and try again.
Installs the Nino TV app on your LG TV (webOS) from this phone, without a computer. The phone and the TV must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Needs LG\'s Developer Mode app on the TV and a free LG developer account. Nino extends the developer mode session for you.
No LG TV found. Is the TV on and on the same Wi-Fi? You can also type its address below (on the TV: Settings › General › Network › the connected network).
Passphrase (key saved; type it if needed)
Turn on developer mode on the TV
1. Create a free LG developer account at webostv.developer.lge.com.
2. On the TV, install the Developer Mode app from the LG Content Store, open it, sign in with your account and turn on Dev Mode Status. The TV restarts.
3. Open the Developer Mode app again and turn on Key Server. Leave the app on screen; a 6-character Passphrase appears at the bottom left.
4. Type the Passphrase above and press Install and open. The passphrase is only needed for the first install.

Developer mode stays on for at most 1000 hours. The phone does not extend it: before it runs out, press EXTEND in the TV\'s Developer Mode app (Nino on a computer does this by itself). If it runs out, the TV app is removed.
The TV did not respond. Make sure the TV is on and on the same Wi-Fi as this phone, and that Dev Mode Status is on in the Developer Mode app.
Key Server is off. Turn it on in the Developer Mode app and keep the app on screen.
The passphrase is not correct. Check it on the TV screen.
The TV refused the key. Open Key Server and type the passphrase again.
On the TV, answer Allow to “Allow USB debugging?” (tick “Always allow from this device”).
Getting the developer key from the TV…
Installs the Nino Android TV app on your Android TV or Google TV from this phone, without a computer. The phone and the TV must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Debugging must be on in the TV\'s developer options. Leave it on so updates can be installed.
No Android TV found. Is the TV on and on the same Wi-Fi? You can also type its address below (on the TV: Settings › Network & Internet › the connected network).
IP address and port in the pairing window
Pairing code (6 digits; leave empty if already paired)
With wireless debugging, type the TV\'s port too: the “IP address & Port” at the top of the TV\'s Wireless debugging screen (e.g. 192.168.1.20:41235).
Next to the pairing code, type the IP address and port from the pairing window too (e.g. 192.168.1.20:37099).
Turn on debugging on the TV
1. Turn on developer options: on the TV, open Settings › System (or Device Preferences) › About and press the Android TV OS build row 7 times.
2. In Settings › System › Developer options, turn on USB debugging. Some TVs also have “Network debugging” or “ADB over network”; turn that on too.

3. Press Install and open. When the TV asks “Allow USB debugging?”, tick “Always allow from this device” and choose Allow. If it cannot connect, try the Wireless debugging option (Android 11 and later, Google TV).
2. Turn on Developer options › Wireless debugging and open it. Type the “IP address & Port” at the top as the TV\'s address.
3. The first time, press “Pair device with pairing code”; type the IP address and port from that window together with the 6-digit code, and press Install and open while the window is still open.
Remove the TV\'s copy and install

The TV did not respond. Make sure the TV is on and on the same Wi-Fi as this phone, and that debugging is on in its developer options. With wireless debugging the port changes every time; type the one on the screen.
Debugging was not allowed on the TV. Try again and choose Allow on the TV.
The TV does not know this phone. With wireless debugging, pair first: press “Pair device with pairing code” on the TV, type the address and the code from that window and try again.
Pairing failed: the code is wrong or the pairing window on the TV closed. Open the window again, type the new code and port and try again.

Nino on the TV was installed from Google Play and this version could not be installed over it. You can keep using the Play version; Play brings the update itself. To install this version now, the button below removes the TV\'s copy and installs the new one (the TV app\'s settings are deleted).

Nino TV on the TV is signed with another key (0.9.18 and earlier were signed with an old key) or is newer than this phone\'s, so this version cannot be installed over it. The button below removes the TV\'s copy and installs the new one; the TV app\'s settings are deleted. If that fails, on the TV go to Settings › Apps › Nino TV › Uninstall, then press Install and open here.

The old Nino TV could not be removed from the TV, so the new one cannot be installed. Remove it on the TV yourself: Settings › Apps › See all apps › Nino TV › Uninstall. Then press Install and open here.
The last %1$d translated lines are kept on this phone.
No subtitles yet. Lines translated in this and earlier sessions appear here.
All saved lines are removed from this phone.
Drag the frame to move it, or drag its corner to resize it.
The game picture appears here once translating starts.

Besides the subtitle, Nino can keep reading up to three small areas, like a quest, a phone message or a notification. Each area is read about once a second and translated again only when its text changes. The translation shows on the TV and on this phone\'s subtitle screen, where the original text is.
This is not a valid IP address. Type it like 192.168.1.20, without http:// or a port number.
The key did not work. Check it and try again.
Start translation first; the test subtitle shows once the TV app connects to the phone.
This is a test subtitle. Can you see it on top of the game?
Sign in with your Microsoft account and choose your Xbox first.
Plug in to turn on %1$s subtitles
Plug it in: Nino opens on the TV and subtitles start.
Slide to start; subtitles flow on the screen above.
Game packs are used only for Turkish.
Network, PS5 connection, picture and translation speed
The phone\'s network, the PS5 connection, how smooth the picture is and translation speed. If something is wrong, it says what to do.
If you have a problem, send this to whoever is helping you.
The phone is not connected to the internet or the home network.
Connect to the same Wi-Fi as the PS5; the PS5 cannot be found over mobile data.
Wi-Fi looks weak. Move closer to the router, use the 5 GHz network, connect the PS5 by cable.
Is the PS5 on and on the same network? In rest mode, Settings › Power Saving › \"Stay connected to the internet\" and \"Enable turning on PS5 from network\" must be on.
The connection drops often; the network may be weak.
The PS5 picture is choppy; subtitles may be read late or partly. Wi-Fi is usually the cause.
Translation is slow. The internet may be slow; try another translation engine in Settings.
Open the Nino app on the TV; the phone and the TV must be on the same network.
Subtitles show up here once translation starts.
Pair your PS5 to get started.
No translations yet. They appear here as soon as a subtitle shows up in the game.
Turn your phone sideways or tap here
Turn your phone sideways for full screen
Subtitles appear in large text on this phone; just place the phone next to the TV or monitor.
Where should Nino read the game picture from?
Over Wi-Fi with Remote Play; needs a second PSN account
HDMI card plugged in over USB-C
The PS5 picture is read over Wi-Fi with Remote Play. A second PSN account and PS5 pairing are needed.
Connect your PS5 or Xbox to the Capture Card\'s HDMI input and the card to this phone over USB-C. No sign-in or pairing is needed; subtitles still appear on the TV or on this phone.
On the PS5, turn off Settings › System › HDMI › Enable HDCP; otherwise the card shows a black picture. Xbox usually does not use HDCP in games.
Plug the card in over USB-C
No Capture Card found. Plug the card in over USB-C; your phone may not support external cameras (Android 14+).
No camera permission. Android sees the Capture Card as a camera; please give Nino camera permission.
The picture is black. Turn on the PS5, or turn off Settings › System › HDMI › Enable HDCP on the PS5.
Reading and translating subtitles from the Capture Card
Which Console Do You Play On?
Nino reads the game picture from your console over Wi-Fi.
Remote Play; needs a second PSN account
Xbox Series X|S; your Microsoft account is enough
The PS5 picture is read with Remote Play. In the next step you will sign in with a second PSN account and pair your PS5.

The Xbox picture is read with home streaming (Remote Play). In the next step you will sign in with your Microsoft account and choose your Xbox. You can choose a Capture Card in Settings › Video Source.
Over Wi-Fi with a Microsoft account
The Xbox picture is read over Wi-Fi with home streaming. You need to sign in with a Microsoft account and choose your Xbox; Remote features must be on on the Xbox.
Your Microsoft sign-in expired. Sign in again in Settings › Console.
This Microsoft account has no Xbox profile. Sign in with the account you use on your Xbox.
Can\'t reach your Xbox. Is it on, and is remote play enabled in Settings › Devices & connections › Remote features? Retrying…
Your Xbox is in another remote play session. Close it; retrying…
The Xbox service sent an unexpected reply. Retrying…
The Xbox connection was lost: %1$s. Restart the Xbox to reconnect.
Choose the console whose subtitles you want translated. You can change it later in Settings.
With Remote Play and a second PSN account.
With home streaming and your own Microsoft account. No second account needed.
Sign in with the Microsoft account you use on your Xbox. The phone watches your Xbox home stream; your game keeps running.
Tap the button to get a code. The Microsoft sign-in page doesn\'t open inside the app: you enter the code at microsoft.com/link in your browser.

1. The code is copied and microsoft.com/link is open in your browser. If it didn\'t open, tap the link above.\n2. Paste the code, sign in with the Microsoft account you use on your Xbox and allow access.\n3. Come back to Nino; sign-in finishes on its own.
Couldn\'t open a browser. Open %1$s on another device and enter the code there.
Waiting for you to finish signing in…
Samsung, LG, Android TV · over Wi-Fi, no computer
The Xboxes on your account. On the Xbox, turn on Settings › Devices & connections › Remote features.
No Xbox found on this account. Sign in on your Xbox with the same account and turn on remote features.
Remote play off: turn on Remote features on the Xbox
Xbox support is in Beta. If something goes wrong, tell us and we\'ll fix it as soon as we can.
Couldn\'t connect to the internet. Check your connection and try again.
The Xbox service sent an unexpected reply (%1$s).
Tell us if something went wrong
What happened? Which game, what did you expect?
A photo couldn\'t be opened. Try another one.
Helps us find the problem. No passwords or keys are included.
The report couldn\'t be sent. Check your internet connection and try again.
The report is too large. Remove a photo and try again.
The report wasn\'t accepted. Check your description and try again.
You\'ve sent many reports today. Please try again tomorrow.
Your description, photos and (if on) the app log are sent to Nino\'s server so we can fix the problem. Don\'t include passwords.
Hi! I\'m Nino 👋 You can ask me anything about setting up. First, tell me: which devices do you have? (PS5 or Xbox, TV or monitor, phone or computer) Where do you want to set it up?
How do I install the TV app?
I\'m almost ready! Until then, send your question with Report a Problem and the team will answer.
You\'ve asked a lot today 🙂 Let\'s continue tomorrow.
I\'m very busy right now, try again in a bit.
I couldn\'t reach the server. Check your internet and try again.
That message got too big. Remove a screenshot and try again.
I couldn\'t send that message. Change it a little and try again.
Nino: Subtitle Translation Started. Enjoy the Game!
Added to your problem reports so we can see what you use without asking. It contains no names, serial numbers or addresses.

In GTA 6 the Turkish subtitles come from Nino\'s shared translation: every line is translated once by a strong AI and everyone gets the same result. You do not choose anything or enter a key, and it is free.
